wikipedia.title: Lom people
wikipedia.intro:
The Lom people, also known by non-Loms as Bosha or Posha, are an ethnic group originating from the Indian subcontinent.
Their Lomavren language is a mixed language, combining an Indo-Aryan substrate with Armenian.
